options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Detailed Solution:
Detailed Solution:
Ban Ki-moon established UN Women in 2010. Kurt Waldheim oversaw major humanitarian relief in newly independent Bangladesh during 1972-81. Boutros Boutros-Ghali issued the seminal 1992 report 'An Agenda for Peace'. Kofi Annan famously declared the 2003 US-led invasion of Iraq illegal under the UN Charter in 2004.
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For UN Security Council Composition and Veto Power (International Organisations in a Changing World):
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Pol Science (International Organisations - UN Security Council Composition and Veto Power):
Under the UN Charter, the five permanent members of the Security Council are the United States, Russia (successor to the USSR), the United Kingdom, France, and China. Each permanent member possesses the power to veto any substantive resolution.

Hence, Option (C) is the correct answer.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.
